name: Holiday Canned Jellied Cranberry Sauce (Seedless Strained) vs. Whole-Berry Sauce
brandOrRestaurant: Ocean Spray / Thanksgiving & Christmas Holiday Table
whyItWorks: Classic canned Jellied Cranberry Sauce is 100% strained of all tough cranberry skins and seeds, leaving only smooth pectin-rich fruit gel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always choose the smooth Canned Jellied Cranberry Sauce (the kind with the can ridges!) and skip homemade Whole-Berry Cranberry Sauce (which contains tough skins, seeds, and often orange zest).
watchOuts: Never eat homemade Whole-Berry Cranberry Relish (tough skins + frequent orange peel/zest)
